description: Dual-career household decision aid ported from ApexLogics Apex #92 (AL-99). Three coupled legs in one pass: (Tab 1) childcare break-even; total annual childcare from a per-child cost times child count, the gross salary at which a partner's after-tax contribution covers it (cost / (1 - combined effective tax rate/100)), the partner's after-tax net contribution, and the household after-tax income with both partners working versus one; (Tab 2) sabbatical true cost; direct income lost over the months out, lost employer 401k match on it, and a 10-year compounding opportunity cost of the reduced contribution track net of the direct loss already counted; (Tab 3) relocation; nominal household change between cities plus a cost-of-living-adjusted restatement of the destination household in origin dollars (origin COL / dest COL), and a heuristic re-employment break-even of 3 months of search per $10,000 of the lower-earning partner's pay cut. Tax above or at 100%, a zero-current household, or a zero destination COL return null legs with a DIV_ZERO_GUARD flag instead of the page's Infinity/NaN. The city cost-of-living index is the Apex page's own select table (UNGROUNDED, user-overridable); the BLS CES 2024 banner vintage is informational only; no numeric vintage constant enters the arithmetic (payload DIFFERS.md Rows 1-3, CITES.md U1).
